items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Phil Schaap, in 1975, I believe it was, asked me to come over to the West End.

ctx.x: Well, I'd better. Getting back to my activities as a pianist, Phil Schaap, in 1975, I believe it was, asked me to

come over to the West End. That's another re-entry into the music world. I went back into it again, after, you know, being involved in the problems in Harlem. And I went back to the West End and I predicted that that place would become, you know, one of the real musical arenas in America, you know, and that people...people will have an opportunity to enjoy...that's the nearest thing to real jazz. I'm not talking about the modern emporiums and all that, I'm talking about...that's the nearest here. thing to jazz…
